content: To mitigate this problem, we propose using a leaf-LSTM following the convention of some previous works BIBREF21 , BIBREF7 , BIBREF11 , which is a typical LSTM that accepts a sequence of words in order. Instead of leveraging word embeddings directly, we can use each hidden state and cell state of the leaf-LSTM as input tokens for leaf nodes in a tree-LSTM, anticipating the proper contextualization of the input sequence.
